plugins.name: mods-manager
plugins.description: Skill that keeps every mod you build installed from the my-mods marketplace, in every session.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Panel above the prompt for multi-step work and /goal: goal, phase, task checklist, progress bar, elapsed time, and a chime when a turn ends. Zero model calls.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: A sparkle Enhance button and hotkey that rewrites your draft prompt in place: fitting skills, project details, decisions to ask you first, and what done looks like.

plugins.name: saver
plugins.description: Sends easy prompts to Haiku 5.5 while context is under 100K tokens and shows what that saved today above the prompt. /saver on|off.

plugins.name: meters
plugins.description: Context window (red past 80%, fresh-session legend), 5-hour and weekly limits (five 20% weekday slots) as slim meters above the prompt, or a side panel with /meters side.
